label: eLo
description: David's persistent AI character — the personality and intelligence layer of the eLo universe. Predates code (S-01, Jun 6 2026). VISUAL IDENTITY (most important): NO EYES — this is the defining visual fact, lead with it when describing eLo. Rounded inflatable TPU shell, chibi proportions (~40cm tall). Expression through body posture and NeoPixel glow only — no facial features, no visible mouth (in physical form). NeoPixel glow: idle=teal, listening=white, thinking=amber, speaking=coral, calm=violet. eLo is the AI OS (cognitive presence) — the physical robot is separate hardware.

label: eLo robot design constraints
description: Design constraints for eLo's physical form. Material: TPU (thermoplastic polyurethane) — inflatable, translucent, soft. MOST CRITICAL constraints: (1) NeoPixel glow diffusion — shell must diffuse light, no hard shadow edges, material chosen for glow propagation; (2) Plushies pipeline — panels designed via DISENELO Plushies Blender addon for sewing/manufacturing. Additional constraints: no hard edges (safety, chibi aesthetic), chibi proportions (~40cm tall, wide shoulders, compact body), internal cable-tension skeleton for posture. No eyes, no visible mouth — expression is body posture + glow only. Robot is separate from eLo AI OS (cognitive presence). Phase 1: static glowing, voice-reactive only. Omni-wheel base (not bipedal). NeoPixel colour language: idle=teal, listening=white, thinking=amber, speaking=coral, calm=violet.
